name: dropdown-menu
description: A menu of actions opened from a button (⋯). Supports labels, separators, shortcuts, checkbox / radio items and submenus.

properties.value: Enter / Space / ↓ open, arrows move, typeahead, Esc closes and returns focus

constraints: Use for actions; use Select for picking a value.
Put destructive items last, after a separator.
Icon-only triggers need an aria-label ("More actions").

When a menu item opens a Dialog, AlertDialog or Sheet, set modal={false} on DropdownMenu. A modal menu sets body pointer-events: none; the overlay opened from it restores that value when it closes, leaving the whole page unclickable.

notes: Installed 2026-09-22 with AI Elements for the chat panel. Stock source adapted to Enpath: Phosphor icons, light-only classes, shadcn colour names rewritten to Enpath tokens.

changelog.change: Documented: menus whose items open a Dialog / Sheet must be modal={false} — otherwise the page stays unclickable after the overlay closes (found in Setup → Duplicate position).

Text uses Enpath text styles (text-body-sm, text-heading-md …, see Foundations/Text Styles) instead of mixed size and weight classes. Labels (label-*) and small headings (heading-sm/xs) are Medium 500.

docs.intro:
# DropdownMenu

A menu of actions opened from a button (⋯). Supports labels, separators, shortcuts, checkbox / radio items and submenus.

---

sections.title: What it is
sections.body:
Radix DropdownMenu. For actions, not for choosing a form value (use Select for that).

**Exports:** `DropdownMenu` · `DropdownMenuTrigger` · `DropdownMenuContent` · `DropdownMenuItem` · `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` · `DropdownMenuRadioItem` · `DropdownMenuLabel` · `DropdownMenuSeparator` · `DropdownMenuShortcut` · `DropdownMenuGroup` · `DropdownMenuPortal` · `DropdownMenuSub` · `DropdownMenuSubContent` · `DropdownMenuSubTrigger` · `DropdownMenuRadioGroup`

---

sections.title: Token Bindings
sections.body:
| Part | Token |
|---|---|
| Fill | `color/surface/overlay` |
| Text | `color/surface/overlay/foreground` |
| Highlighted item | `color/surface/accent` + `/foreground` |
| Label · shortcut | `color/text/secondary` |
| Destructive item | `color/text/invalid` |
| Separator | `color/border/default` |

---

doNot.wrong: DropdownMenu to pick a form value
Hiding the only way to do a primary action in a menu
Open a Dialog or Sheet from an item of a modal DropdownMenu
doNot.correct: Use <DropdownMenu modal={false}> for menus whose items open overlays (e.g. Setup's "More actions": History, Duplicate position)
